name: Brenner (Italy)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of white, red and white, charged with the municipal arms of Brenner (three shields: a mountain, a pick and hammer, and the Tyrolean eagle).
history: Municipal flag of Brenner, a comune in Trentino-South Tyrol; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Brenner arms — three shields with a mountain, a pick and hammer, and the Tyrolean eagle
